explainer.heading: The ends are the oldest part of each hair
body: On long hair, the ends have been through a great many washes, brushings, sun and blow-drying. The outer layer wears away, so the ends turn dry and split.

A mask is thicker than conditioner and stays on longer. According to the description on the label, the blend of shea butter, keratin, collagen and peptides nourishes dry strands, helping hair look smoother and break less with regular use.

blocks.intro: These four names are printed in the Hairroot Boost Complex panel on the label. No concentrations are printed.
blocks.caption: The full ingredient list published by the seller includes cyclopentasiloxane and dimethiconol, both silicones. If you need to avoid silicones, read the INCI list on the packaging before use.

blocks.heading: How to use the mask

items.heading: Wash and rinse out the shampoo
items.body: Squeeze out excess water so the cream does not get diluted.

items.heading: Apply from mid-lengths to ends
items.body: Take enough cream and apply 10–15 cm away from the roots. Do not put it on the scalp.

items.heading: Leave for a few minutes
items.body: The brand's instruction graphic says 5–10 minutes; the shop listing says 1–3 minutes. The drier the hair, the longer within that range.

items.heading: Rinse well
items.body: Rinse thoroughly with clean water and pat dry with a soft towel.

blocks.footnote: The brand suggests the mask once or twice a week as part of the wash, mask, scalp-roller routine.

items.q: How many grams is the jar?
items.a: Most of the brand's images show 200g on the jar label. Some newer packaging images show 170g. When we call to confirm the order, ask the adviser which size is being shipped.

The full ingredient list published by the seller includes cyclopentasiloxane and dimethiconol, both silicones. One of the brand's ad images says “silicone-free”, so the two sources disagree. If you avoid silicones, read the INCI list on the packaging before use.
It goes where conditioner would: after shampoo, before the final rinse. The mask is thicker and stays on longer than a conditioner.
Keep the lid tightly closed and keep water out of the jar. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and out of reach of children.
